# Copilot Instructions for Dashboard CIB2B

<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

## Project Context
This is a React TypeScript dashboard application called "dashboard-cib2b" built with Vite. The dashboard is designed for business-to-business (B2B) operations.

## Code Style and Conventions
- Use TypeScript for all components and utilities
- Follow React functional components with hooks
- Use modern ES6+ syntax
- Implement responsive design patterns
- Use CSS modules or styled-components for styling
- Follow clean code principles and SOLID design patterns

## Dashboard-Specific Guidelines
- Create reusable dashboard components (cards, charts, tables, etc.)
- Implement data visualization components
- Use proper TypeScript interfaces for data models
- Focus on performance and accessibility
- Implement proper error handling and loading states
- Follow dashboard UI/UX best practices

## Dependencies and Tools
- React 18+ with TypeScript
- Vite for build tooling
- Consider using popular libraries like:
  - Material-UI, Ant Design, or Chakra UI for components
  - Chart.js, Recharts, or D3.js for data visualization
  - React Router for navigation
  - Axios or React Query for API calls
